source.content: public class BatchLifecycleFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Integer> { public Iterable<Integer> start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { System.assert(System.isBatch()); System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); System.assertEquals('', bc.getChildJobId()); insert new Account(Name = 'start:' + bc.getJobId()); return new List<Integer>{1, 2, 3, 4, 5}; } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Integer> scope) { System.assert(System.isBatch()); System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); insert new Account(Name = 'execute:' + bc.getJobId() + ':' + scope.size()); } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { System.assert(System.isBatch()); System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); insert new Account(Name = 'finish:' + bc.getJobId()); AsyncApexJob job = [SELECT Id, Status, JobType, TotalJobItems, JobItemsProcessed, NumberOfErrors, CompletedDate FROM AsyncApexJob WHERE Id = :bc.getJobId()]; System.assertEquals('Completed', job.Status); System.assertEquals('BatchApex', job.JobType); System.assertEquals(3, job.TotalJobItems); System.assertEquals(3, job.JobItemsProcessed); System.assertEquals(0, job.NumberOfErrors); System.assertNotEquals(null, job.CompletedDate); } }

public class BatchDefaultScopeFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Integer> { public Iterable<Integer> start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { return new List<Integer>{1, 2, 3}; } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Integer> scope) { insert new Account(Name = 'default-execute:' + bc.getJobId() + ':' + scope.size()); } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { AsyncApexJob job = [SELECT Id, Status, TotalJobItems, JobItemsProcessed, NumberOfErrors FROM AsyncApexJob WHERE Id = :bc.getJobId()]; System.assertEquals('Completed', job.Status); System.assertEquals(1, job.TotalJobItems); System.assertEquals(1, job.JobItemsProcessed); System.assertEquals(0, job.NumberOfErrors); } }

@isTest private class AsyncBatchableLifecycleFixtureTest { @isTest static void executesBatchLifecycleAndContext() { Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new BatchLifecycleFixtureBatch(), 2); System.assertNotEquals('', jobId); Test.stopTest(); String startName = 'start:' + jobId; String executeTwoName = 'execute:' + jobId + ':2'; String executeOneName = 'execute:' + jobId + ':1'; String finishName = 'finish:' + jobId; System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :startName]); System.assertEquals(2, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :executeTwoName]); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :executeOneName]); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :finishName]); } @isTest static void executesDefaultScopeOverload() { Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new BatchDefaultScopeFixtureBatch()); Test.stopTest(); String executeName = 'default-execute:' + jobId + ':3'; System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :executeName]); } }
